decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=READ, dst=<path label 0:1>/sensor/temp, src=/reply-ep, VALUE u32=9 } - the labelled request a hop refuses once the vertex the label stood for has departed (RFC-0027 7.1/7.2).
decoded.note: Identical bytes serve both outcomes: against a live slot this forwards over the link the label names, and against a bumped generation it answers tr::path::not_found (0x0020) and delivers nothing. The frame cannot tell you which - staleness is table state, not wire state, which is exactly why this vector's behavioural half is bound by a core test.
